title: Al-Adab al-Mufrad Series (Imam al-Bukhari)
description: Imam al-Bukhari's Al-Adab al-Mufrad (The Book of Manners) - a hadith collection dedicated entirely to adab: rights of parents and kinship, care for orphans and neighbours, generosity, and the Prophet's own noble character. Twelve lessons from Abu Khadeejah's series with Salafi explanations.
short_description: Imam al-Bukhari's Book of Manners, lesson by lesson

modules.title: Family & Kinship
modules.description: Parents, relatives, children and the rights between them.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 - The Different Rights of Parents
lessons.content: The different categories of parents' rights and how each is fulfilled. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 7 - Great Sins: Shirk, Ill Treatment of Parents and Lying
lessons.content: Three great sins: shirk, disobedience to parents, and lying. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 19 - Do Not Cut Ties With Your Relatives
lessons.content: The warning against severing family ties (silat ar-rahim). Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 21 - The Conversion of Abu Hurairah's Mother
lessons.content: The story of how the Prophet (peace be upon him) called Abu Hurairah's mother to Islam - and her answer to his du'a. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 22 - Making Du'a for Deceased Parents Raises Them in Rank
lessons.content: Continuing du'a for deceased parents elevates their rank - and the child still gains reward. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 37 - Look After Your Daughters
lessons.content: The virtue and obligation of raising and caring for daughters. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 42 - The Companions Were Severely Tried
lessons.content: The trials the companions faced and their patience - lessons for believers today. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

modules.title: Neighbors, Wealth & Society
modules.description: Adab with neighbours, generosity, and the wider Ummah.

lessons.title: Lesson 52 - The Best of You Is the One Best to His Neighbours
lessons.content: The Prophet's statement on being good to neighbours - the scale of true goodness. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 55 - Belittling Gifts, Dealing With Bad Neighbours
lessons.content: Never belittle a gift, and how to deal with a bad neighbour. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 82 - Jihad of the Soul & Aiding Others for Allah's Sake
lessons.content: The greater jihad - the struggle of the soul - and the virtue of helping others purely for Allah. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 85 - How the Poor Can Give Charity
lessons.content: Charity in every form: how those with little can still give. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 86 - Removing Something Harmful From the Path
lessons.content: The smallest acts of charity: removing harm from the road - even a branch. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 97 - The Character of the Prophet as Stated in the Torah
lessons.content: The description of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in the earlier scriptures - affirming his prophethood. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani
